intent_record.intent_summary: Allow multiple processes to open the same hvpipe source by removing the exclusive access check and automatic cleanup, changing the driver's concurrency model.
intent_record.what: Removed the early check that prevented multiple processes from using the same source, including the spinlock, source lookup, error message, and -EALREADY return. Also removed the __free(kfree) attribute from the src_info pointer declaration.
intent_record.how: Previously, the function would return -EALREADY if a source was already in use by another process. Now it always proceeds to allocate a new src_info without any duplicate check, potentially allowing multiple processes to access the same source. Memory cleanup is no longer automatic via __free; manual cleanup would be required on error paths.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix race condition and error handling in papr_hvpipe source handle creation by serializing access before FD creation and ensuring proper cleanup on failure paths.
intent_record.what: Reordered operations in papr_hvpipe_dev_create_handle: moved lock acquisition before file descriptor creation, changed to use FD_ADD instead of FD_PREPARE/fd_publish, added proper cleanup for duplicate source (kfree, pr_err) and for FD allocation failure (list removal, pending message consumption), removed retain_and_null_ptr call.
intent_record.how: Eliminates a race condition where two processes could both create file descriptors for the same source ID. Ensures memory is freed on duplicate source error. Prevents resource leak and blocks hypervisor by cleaning up list entry and consuming pending messages when FD allocation fails.
